note: Technique repertoire: one short card per technique or psychology principle. Checked by tools/technique.mjs check. Cards with kind "external" give the instruction or prompt for a tool outside the kit. Areas: layout, type, color, motion, imagery, 3d, svg, interaction, content, direction, psychology.

cards.title: Bento grid
cards.when: 4 to 8 features or facts of different weight that should be read at a glance.
cards.when_not: Content read in order (article, steps) or a single message.
steps: Use a 12-column grid; make 1 or 2 tiles span 2x the others.
Same radius, padding and surface on every tile.
One idea per tile: a title, one line, one visual.
At 360 px stack in one column, big tile first.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: overflow-x, spacing-off-scale; by hand: one tile dominates.
cards.fallback: A plain 3-column card grid with equal tiles.

cards.title: Asymmetric layout
cards.when: A hero or feature that must feel less like a template and still read in one pass.
cards.when_not: Forms, tables and dense dashboards.
steps: Split 7/5 or 8/4 columns instead of 6/6.
Put the text on the heavy side, the visual on the light side.
Keep one left edge for headings and text.
Stack in the order text, visual at 360 px.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: overflow-x, overlap at 360 and 768.
cards.fallback: A centered two-column 6/6 split.

cards.title: Controlled broken grid
cards.when: One signature moment (hero, quote) that breaks the grid on purpose.
cards.when_not: More than one break per page, or any text that must stay readable.
steps: Keep the grid; let exactly one element cross a column edge by up to one column.
Never let the break cover text or a control.
Remove the offset below md so nothing overflows.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: overflow-x, overlap, target-small at 360.
cards.fallback: Align the element to the grid.

cards.title: Section rhythm
cards.when: A long page that starts to feel flat after three sections.
cards.when_not: Short pages and tools where each screen has one job.
steps: Alternate dense and light sections (text, big visual, space, proof, call to action).
Mark every second section with another surface token, not more margin.
Keep the same section padding everywhere.
Use at most one dark band per page unless the whole theme is dark.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: spacing-off-scale; recipe.mjs show <id> lists the order.
cards.fallback: Same background and a divider between sections.

cards.title: Z and F reading patterns
cards.when: Choosing where the headline, visual and call to action go.
cards.when_not: Centered single-message pages where nothing competes.
steps: Landing or visual page (Z): logo and menu top, headline and visual middle, call to action bottom right of the first screen.
Text page, blog, docs (F): heading top left, left-aligned lines, subheads on the left edge.
Put the main action where the eye ends, not in a corner.
cards.check: by hand: the call to action is where the pattern ends.
cards.fallback: Headline top left, call to action right under it.

cards.title: Sticky header or floating action
cards.when: A long page where the main action must stay one tap away.
cards.when_not: Short pages, or a header taller than 64 px on mobile.
steps: Make the header 56 to 64 px with `position: sticky`.
Show one action only, never two.
Do not cover anchors: set `scroll-margin-top` on sections.
A floating button must not hide content or the cookie choice.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: overlap, target-small, multiple-primary at 360.
cards.fallback: A normal header and the action repeated after the proof.

cards.title: Sticky sidebar, index or filters
cards.when: Docs, long articles or catalogs with filters beside the content.
cards.when_not: Below md, where the sidebar becomes a drawer or a top row.
steps: Use `position: sticky; top` equal to the header height.
Limit the sidebar to 240 to 280 px and its own scroll.
Highlight the current section with aria-current.
Collapse into a disclosure above the content at 360 px.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: overflow-x, overlap at 360 and 768.
cards.fallback: A table of contents at the top of the page.

cards.title: Fluid layout with clamp, min and max
cards.when: Spacing and widths that should scale between phone and desktop without more breakpoints.
cards.when_not: Values that must match the spacing scale exactly (use the tokens).
steps: Section padding: `clamp(48px, 8vw, 96px)` mapped to the nearest spacing tokens.
Container: `width: min(100% - 2rem, 72rem)`.
Grids: `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(16rem, 1fr))`.
Test at 360, 768 and 1280.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: overflow-x at 360/768/1280, spacing-off-scale.
cards.fallback: Fixed values per breakpoint from tokens.mjs css.

cards.title: Container queries
cards.when: A card or widget used in a narrow column and in a wide one.
cards.when_not: Whole-page layout (use breakpoints) or when support is not needed.
steps: Set `container-type: inline-size` on the wrapper.
Write `@container (min-width: 28rem)` rules inside the component.
Name the container when nested.
Give a default layout for browsers without support.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: overflow-x and overlap with the component at 360 and 1280.
cards.fallback: Media queries on the parent layout.

cards.title: Density modes
cards.when: Dashboards, catalogs and docs used for long sessions by the same people.
cards.when_not: Marketing pages.
steps: Define compact, regular and spacious as three sets of tokens (control height, gap, padding).
Switch by one data attribute on the root.
Keep targets at 24 px or more even in compact.
Remember the choice.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: target-small in compact; tokens.mjs init --density.
cards.fallback: One regular density.

cards.title: Scroll snapping
cards.when: A story, a gallery or slides where each step should land in place.
cards.when_not: Long text, forms and any page with sticky anchors; never `mandatory` on the page.
steps: Use `scroll-snap-type: y proximity` or x on a carousel.
Set `scroll-snap-align: start` on each item.
Keep every item reachable by keyboard and links.
Turn it off for prefers-reduced-motion.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: no-reduced-motion, overflow-x; by hand: keyboard reaches every item.
cards.fallback: Normal scrolling with anchors.

cards.title: Overlapping layers
cards.when: Depth between an image and a card, or a card over a section edge.
cards.when_not: When an overlap hides text or controls, or at 360 px.
steps: Overlap by a negative margin of one spacing step, not more.
Put the text block on a solid surface.
Set z-index from a short scale.
Remove the overlap below md.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: overlap, z-index-high, contrast-low.
cards.fallback: Place the card below the image with a gap.

cards.title: Full-bleed sections
cards.when: An image, a band or a map that should use the full width while the text stays in the container.
cards.when_not: Text that would run the full width.
steps: Let the background span 100% and keep the content in `container.page`.
Never size by 100vw (it adds a scrollbar width); use 100%.
Put text on a solid or overlayed area and check its contrast.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: overflow-x, contrast-low, line-length.
cards.fallback: The image inside the container with a radius.

cards.title: Split-screen layout
cards.when: Two halves that are compared or paired: text and visual, sign in and pitch.
cards.when_not: More than two ideas, or below md.
steps: Two columns of equal weight, each with one job.
Keep one half fixed and let the other scroll only when it is long.
Stack below md with the task half first.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: overflow-x, overlap at 360/768.
cards.fallback: A normal two-column section.

cards.title: One column on mobile
cards.when: Every page at 360 px: one reading and one action at a time.
cards.when_not: Data tables and maps, which scroll inside their own box.
steps: Stack in the order of importance, not the desktop order.
Full-width controls, 44 px high, 8 to 12 px apart.
No horizontal scroll except inside a table or carousel.
Keep the main action visible without scrolling.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: overflow-x, target-small, text-small, overlap at 360.
cards.fallback: The desktop layout with its columns wrapped by flex.

cards.title: Intentional whitespace
cards.when: A page that feels crowded or cheap and needs less, not more.
cards.when_not: Dense tools where density is the value.
steps: Use the spacing scale only: 8 or 12 inside a group, 24 or 32 between groups, section padding between sections.
Each step at least double the one before.
Remove a border or a box before adding space.
Leave one empty margin around the main action.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: spacing-off-scale; by hand: groups are visibly closer inside than between.
cards.fallback: Double the gaps between groups.

cards.title: Type pairing
cards.when: Choosing the display and the body font of a new design.
cards.when_not: A third family, or two display fonts.
steps: One expressive display font for headings, one neutral font for reading.
Pick them by contrast (serif with sans, or wide with narrow), not by taste.
Set font.display and font.body in the tokens.
Check both on a real heading and a real paragraph.
cards.check: tokens.mjs check; audit-design.mjs: too-many-font-families.
cards.fallback: One family in two weights.

cards.title: Variable font
cards.when: One file should give several weights or widths, or an animated weight.
cards.when_not: A design that uses only two static weights.
steps: Load one variable file with `font-display: swap`.
Use the weight axis for hierarchy (400, 600) instead of more families.
Animate `font-variation-settings` only on short, rare moments.
Keep a static fallback stack.
cards.check: audit-perf.mjs: CLS and LCP stay inside budget.
cards.fallback: Two static weights.

cards.title: Kinetic typography
cards.when: A hero or brand moment where the type is the visual.
cards.when_not: Body text, small text, or pages for people sensitive to motion.
steps: Animate one headline, 400 to 800 ms, transform and opacity only.
Split by words, not letters, for readability.
Stop after one run; no loops.
Provide the static text for reduced motion.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: animate-layout, no-reduced-motion, transition-all.
cards.fallback: A static oversized headline.

cards.title: Oversized headline
cards.when: The headline is the main graphic and has 2 to 6 words.
cards.when_not: Long headlines and narrow screens without fluid sizing.
steps: Size with `clamp()` between the `3xl` and `5xl` tokens.
Tighten line-height to 1 to 1.1 and tracking slightly negative.
Max 3 lines; keep weight at 600 to 800.
Check it at 360 px without overflow.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: overflow-x, text-clipped, too-many-font-sizes.
cards.fallback: The `4xl` token at a heavy weight.

cards.title: Fluid type
cards.when: Headings that must scale smoothly between phone and desktop.
cards.when_not: Body text, which stays at the base token.
steps: `font-size: clamp(min, preferred, max)` with min and max from the scale tokens.
Preferred value in vw plus a rem part so zoom still works.
Test at 360 and 1280.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: font-size-off-scale, too-many-font-sizes, overflow-x.
cards.fallback: One size at md and below, one above.

cards.title: Line height and tracking
cards.when: Text that looks cramped or loose.
cards.when_not: Never skip it; it is cheap.
steps: Body: line-height 1.5 to 1.7. Headings: 1.05 to 1.25.
Large headings: letter-spacing -0.01 to -0.03em. Small caps labels: +0.05 to +0.1em.
Keep the line at 45 to 90 characters.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: line-length.
cards.fallback: 1.5 for all text.

cards.title: Hierarchy by size and weight
cards.when: Levels that look alike, or color used alone to rank text.
cards.when_not: More than 3 text sizes in one view.
steps: Rank by size, then by weight (600 vs 400), then by color.
Use at most 3 sizes and 2 weights in one view.
Keep the same role in the same style everywhere.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: too-many-font-sizes.
cards.fallback: Bold headings, regular body.

cards.title: Text on image
cards.when: A headline over a photo or a gradient.
cards.when_not: Busy photos with no way to calm them; long text over an image.
steps: Prefer text beside the image; if over it, add a solid or a gradient overlay of 40 to 60 %.
Keep the text on the calm part of the photo.
Measure the contrast on the worst spot.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: contrast-low (it skips image backgrounds: check them with tokens.mjs contrast).
cards.fallback: A solid panel under the text.

cards.title: Tabular numbers
cards.when: Prices, metrics, tables and counters that line up or change.
cards.when_not: Running text.
steps: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` on every figure column.
Right-align numbers; align decimals.
Use one currency and decimal format.
cards.check: by hand: digits do not jump when a value changes.
cards.fallback: A monospace font for figures.

cards.title: Link and text-button states
cards.when: Every link, so people can tell it is one.
cards.when_not: Never skip focus.
steps: Links inside text: underline or color plus underline.
Define hover, focus-visible, active and visited states.
Link text says the target: "Read the pricing", not "click here".
Keep the focus ring at 2 px or more.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: outline-removed, contrast-low.
cards.fallback: Underline all links.

cards.title: Fallback and self-hosted fonts
cards.when: Any web font, to avoid jumps and third-party requests.
cards.when_not: System font designs.
steps: Self-host WOFF2, preload the one used above the fold.
`font-display: swap` and a fallback stack with matching metrics.
Declare `size-adjust` for the fallback to avoid layout shift.
cards.check: audit-perf.mjs: CLS under 0.1.
cards.fallback: The system font stack.

cards.title: Avoid the default AI fonts
cards.when: The brief asks for personality and the first pick is Inter, Roboto, Poppins or Montserrat.
cards.when_not: Utility products where neutral is the goal.
steps: List the default fonts you would pick; discard them.
Pick from a source in the catalog or an open font with a distinct shape.
Test it at heading size and at body size; keep it only if both read well.
cards.check: by hand: the display font is not the first default; tokens.mjs check.
cards.fallback: The default font in a distinctive weight and tracking.

cards.title: Gradient with a purpose
cards.when: One background or highlight that needs depth.
cards.when_not: The generic blue to purple hero gradient, or gradients under text.
steps: Use two hues that are close on the wheel from your tokens.
Use it in one place (hero background or one highlight).
Keep text on a flat or darkened area.
Check the contrast at the lightest point under the text.
cards.check: tokens.mjs contrast <fg> <bg> on the worst point; audit-design.mjs: color-literal.
cards.fallback: A flat surface token.

cards.title: Duotone images
cards.when: Photos from different sources that must look like one set.
cards.when_not: Product photos where the real color matters.
steps: Pick the dark and light tones from the tokens.
Apply with CSS `mix-blend-mode` or an SVG filter; or prepare the file with an external tool.
Use it for backgrounds and cards, not for the product.
cards.check: by hand: set looks consistent; audit-design.mjs: contrast-low.
cards.fallback: A grayscale filter plus a tinted overlay.

cards.title: Editorial palette
cards.when: Content-led brands with a voice: magazines, studios, portfolios.
cards.when_not: Dashboards with many states.
steps: Off-white background, near-black text, one strong accent.
Type carries the design; no gradients.
Generate the ramps from the accent with tokens.mjs init --primary <hex>.
cards.check: tokens.mjs check (contrast pairs).
cards.fallback: Black on white with one accent.

cards.title: Industrial palette
cards.when: Technical, field and manufacturing products.
cards.when_not: Playful or wellness brands.
steps: Neutral greys and near-black, one safety accent (orange or green).
Monospace for data.
Use the accent for state and action only.
Add success, warning and danger tokens that are not the accent.
cards.check: tokens.mjs check; audit-design.mjs: color-literal.
cards.fallback: Grey scale plus one accent.

cards.title: Premium palette
cards.when: High-price services, fashion, hospitality.
cards.when_not: Mass-market, value-led brands.
steps: Black or deep navy or deep green, cream or beige surfaces, one metallic or muted accent.
Few colors, large margins, no saturated buttons.
Test the accent text on cream: it often fails 4.5:1.
cards.check: tokens.mjs contrast <accent> <cream>; tokens.mjs check.
cards.fallback: Black, cream and one accent.

cards.title: Brutalist palette
cards.when: Statements, art and developer culture that want a raw look.
cards.when_not: Products that need calm and trust.
steps: High contrast flat colors, hard borders, no gradients or soft shadows.
Two or three colors only; one loud accent.
Keep body text at AAA-like contrast.
cards.check: tokens.mjs check; audit-design.mjs: contrast-low.
cards.fallback: Black, white and one primary color.

cards.title: Real dark mode
cards.when: The product needs a dark theme, not an inverted one.
cards.when_not: A single-theme brand with no need.
steps: Keep the same semantic roles, change the values (tokens.mjs init --dark).
Lift surfaces by lighter greys (elevation), not by shadow.
Desaturate accents; avoid pure white text on pure black.
Check every state: hover, focus, disabled, error.
cards.check: tokens.mjs check (dark pairs); audit-design.mjs: contrast-low.
cards.fallback: One theme.

cards.title: Do not rely on color alone
cards.when: Any state: error, success, status, charts, links.
cards.when_not: Never skip it.
steps: Pair color with an icon, a word or a shape.
Charts: add labels or patterns.
Check the screen in grayscale and in a color-blind simulation.
cards.check: audit-a11y.mjs (axe); by hand: grayscale screenshot.
cards.fallback: Add a text label to every status.

cards.title: Accent discipline
cards.when: A design with too many colored items.
cards.when_not: Data visualizations that need categories.
steps: About 60 % neutral, 30 % secondary, 10 % accent.
Accent only on the primary action, links and one highlight.
Use semantic tokens (success, warning, danger) for state.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: color-literal, multiple-primary.
cards.fallback: Make everything neutral except the main button.

cards.title: Art direction of the images
cards.when: Before choosing or making any photo, illustration or render.
cards.when_not: Never skip it; random images are the first sign of a template.
steps: Write 5 lines: subject, framing, light, color treatment, mood.
Tie the color treatment to the tokens.
Give every image slot a size and a job (proof, mood, explanation).
Reject any image that breaks a line.
cards.check: by hand: all images look like one set.
cards.fallback: One treatment for all: same crop ratio and one color filter.

cards.title: Placeholders with the right shape
cards.when: The final image does not exist yet, or loads slowly.
cards.when_not: Never ship a placeholder as the final image.
steps: Set `aspect-ratio` and width and height on every image slot.
Fill with a token surface or a blurred dominant color.
Use svg.mjs gen gradient-mesh or blob for decorative slots.
Add a fallback for avatars: initials on a token color.
cards.check: audit-perf.mjs: CLS; svg.mjs check.
cards.fallback: A flat token surface with the right ratio.

cards.title: Responsive and lazy images
cards.when: Every photo that is not the first thing on the page.
cards.when_not: The hero image: load it eagerly.
steps: `srcset` and `sizes` with 3 widths; AVIF or WebP with a fallback.
`loading="lazy"` and `decoding="async"` below the fold.
Width and height on every `img`.
Preload the hero image only.
cards.check: audit-perf.mjs: LCP under 2.5 s, CLS under 0.1.
cards.fallback: One WebP at 1200 px and lazy loading.

cards.title: Useful alt text
cards.when: Every informative image.
cards.when_not: Decoration: use alt="".
steps: Say what the image shows for the page's purpose, in one sentence.
No "image of"; no repeating the caption.
Text in an image is repeated in the alt.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: img-no-alt (presence only); by hand: meaning.
cards.fallback: alt="" and a caption.

cards.title: Prompt for an image generator
cards.when: Photos or illustrations that do not exist and must be generated outside the kit.
cards.when_not: Real people or products the page claims are real.
steps: Write one prompt: subject, framing, lens, light, palette from the tokens (hex), style, aspect ratio.
Add a negative list: no text, no logos, no extra fingers.
Generate 4, keep one; save the prompt next to the file.
Check the license of the tool and credit it.
cards.check: by hand against art-direction; the file name states its source.
cards.fallback: A stock or catalog image with a clear license.

cards.title: Image editing, fill and upscaling
cards.when: Crop, extend, clean, upscale or vary an existing image.
cards.when_not: Images you do not have the right to change.
steps: State the edit: area, what to remove or add, the ratio, the output size.
Ask for 3 variations; keep the original.
Export WebP or AVIF at 2x the display size.
cards.check: audit-perf.mjs: weight and LCP after export.
cards.fallback: Crop with CSS `object-fit` and `aspect-ratio`.

cards.title: Background removal
cards.when: A product or subject on a clean or colored background.
cards.when_not: Hair and glass edges that need manual cleaning.
steps: Remove the background with an external tool; export PNG or WebP with alpha.
Check edges on dark and light surfaces.
Add a soft shadow in CSS, not baked.
cards.check: by hand: edges on both themes.
cards.fallback: Place the photo in a rounded card.

cards.title: Consistency across generated images
cards.when: A series of images of one character, product or place.
cards.when_not: A single image.
steps: Fix a reference image and reuse it in every prompt.
Reuse the same style, lens and palette lines word for word.
Keep a seed or a style code if the tool gives one.
Review the set side by side.
cards.check: by hand: set side by side.
cards.fallback: Use icons or illustrations from svg.mjs gen.

cards.title: Image moodboard
cards.when: The user wants to see the look before choosing it.
cards.when_not: A direction already approved.
steps: Ask an image generator or a gallery for 6 tiles per direction.
Use the direction's keywords from STYLE-DIRECTIONS.md in each prompt.
Show 3 directions; record the user's choice with memory.mjs add.
cards.check: memory.mjs records the chosen direction.
cards.fallback: Describe each direction in 5 lines with a reference link.

cards.title: Screenshot, mockup or sketch to structure
cards.when: The user supplies a screenshot, a mockup, a photo of a sketch or a URL to imitate in structure.
cards.when_not: Copying a brand's exact look or text.
steps: Ask a vision-capable model: list sections in order, each with its job, layout and type scale.
Do not copy colors, fonts or text; map to the tokens.
Turn the list into UX-SPEC rows and an inventory, then find components in the catalog.
cards.check: flow.mjs report; audit-design.mjs on the result.
cards.fallback: Describe the sections in words and use recipe.mjs suggest.

cards.title: One icon system
cards.when: Any interface with more than 3 icons.
cards.when_not: Never mix styles.
steps: Pick one style: line, solid or duotone; one stroke width; one 24 px grid.
Generate or draw with svg.mjs gen icon-base; use currentColor.
Register them in one sprite (svg.mjs sprite).
Every icon-only button has an aria-label.
cards.check: svg.mjs check --strict; audit-design.mjs: button-no-name.
cards.fallback: One open icon set with a single stroke width.

cards.title: One illustration system
cards.when: Spot illustrations, empty states, dividers and patterns.
cards.when_not: Mixing stock sets.
steps: Fix the rules: palette (tokens), stroke width, corner style, level of detail.
Generate shapes with svg.mjs gen (blob, wave, pattern, frame).
Check each file with svg.mjs check; optimize it.
Use the same shapes for all empty states.
cards.check: svg.mjs check --strict.
cards.fallback: Geometric shapes only, in two token colors.

cards.title: 3D hero object
cards.when: One object or abstract form is the visual of the first screen.
cards.when_not: Pages with a weak device budget, or no fallback image.
steps: Write the scene spec first: object, purpose, camera, light, materials from the tokens, budget, fallback.
One object, slow idle motion, no more than 30 seconds of work to understand.
Load after first paint; show the fallback image first.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
cards.check: audit-perf.mjs: LCP, TBT; audit-design.mjs: no-reduced-motion.
cards.fallback: A static render or video poster.

cards.title: 3D product viewer
cards.when: The user must rotate, zoom or configure a product.
cards.when_not: Products that a photo explains well.
steps: Use a glTF model with one environment light.
Controls: drag to rotate, wheel or pinch to zoom, buttons for color.
Limit zoom and angle; add keyboard controls.
Show a photo gallery as the fallback.
cards.check: audit-perf.mjs: TBT; by hand: keyboard works.
cards.fallback: Photo gallery with 4 angles.

cards.title: Scene setup and composition
cards.when: Any 3D scene: framing, focus and hierarchy.
cards.when_not: 2D pages.
steps: Fix the camera: field of view 35 to 50, one focal subject, rule of thirds.
Background from the token surface; depth of field only if the budget allows.
Keep one point of focus; leave room for the text.
Write these choices in the scene spec.
cards.check: by hand: text is readable over the scene at 360 and 1280.
cards.fallback: A static image with the same composition.

cards.title: 3D materials
cards.when: A surface that must read as metal, glass, plastic, ceramic, fabric, wood or liquid.
cards.when_not: Mobile pages with a tight budget (use flat shading).
steps: Choose roughness and metalness first; then the base color from the tokens.
Glass and liquid cost the most: use them on one object.
Use 1 or 2 compressed textures (KTX2 or WebP) at 1024 px at most.
cards.check: audit-perf.mjs: page weight and LCP.
cards.fallback: A matte material with one color.

cards.title: Lighting presets
cards.when: Choosing the mood of a 3D scene quickly.
cards.when_not: Scenes that need photoreal light baked in an external tool.
steps: Studio: soft key, fill and rim. Cinematic: strong key, dark ambient. Neon: two colored lights from the tokens. Soft: wide, low contrast. Industrial: hard top light.
Use one environment map and at most 3 lights.
Avoid real-time shadows unless on one object.
cards.check: audit-perf.mjs: TBT.
cards.fallback: A single directional light and ambient.

cards.title: Camera path and scroll-linked 3D
cards.when: A product story where the model changes as the user scrolls.
cards.when_not: Pages where scroll must stay predictable, or with reduced motion.
steps: Define 3 to 5 keyframes (position, target) tied to sections.
Map scroll progress to the path with easing; never hijack the scroll.
Keep the text outside the canvas.
Stop the path for prefers-reduced-motion.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: no-reduced-motion; audit-perf.mjs: TBT.
cards.fallback: One static image per section.

cards.title: Interactive 3D
cards.when: The user must select parts, rotate or inspect.
cards.when_not: Decorative 3D.
steps: Pointer and keyboard controls with visible focus.
Highlight the hovered part; show its name in text.
Provide the same information as a list.
Throttle to 30 fps on mobile.
cards.check: by hand: keyboard works; audit-perf.mjs: TBT.
cards.fallback: An annotated image with a list.

cards.title: 2D and accessible fallback for 3D
cards.when: Every 3D piece, before shipping it.
cards.when_not: Never skip it.
steps: Detect WebGL and low-power or reduced-motion; show a poster image or video instead.
Add a text description and a way to skip the scene.
Provide alternative controls (buttons) for gestures.
Keep the content that the 3D conveys in the HTML.
cards.check: audit-a11y.mjs; by hand: page works with WebGL off.
cards.fallback: The poster image.

cards.title: 3D performance budget and lazy loading
cards.when: Any WebGL scene.
cards.when_not: Never skip it.
steps: Budget: model under 2 MB, textures under 3 MB total, under 100k triangles, pixel ratio max 2.
Load the scene when it enters the viewport and after first paint.
Pause rendering when off screen; cap at 60 fps (30 on mobile).
cards.check: audit-perf.mjs: LCP 2.5 s, CLS 0.1, TBT 200 ms.
cards.fallback: The poster image.

cards.title: Depth without WebGL
cards.when: You want volume and depth and have no budget or time for 3D.
cards.when_not: Pages that already have many effects.
steps: Layer 2 or 3 surfaces with soft shadows and one blur.
Use CSS `perspective` and a small `rotateX` on one card.
Add a parallax of 5 to 10 % on one image.
Stop at 2 high-impact effects per view.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: animate-layout, no-reduced-motion, contrast-low.
cards.fallback: A flat card with a border.

cards.title: 3D asset generation
cards.when: A model is needed and does not exist: from a text, an image or a reference.
cards.when_not: A product that exists: use its CAD or a scan.
steps: Write the prompt: object, shape, material, scale, style; add a reference image.
Export glTF or GLB; ask for low poly (under 50k) and clean UVs.
Check licensing and the polygon count; compress with an external tool.
Keep the prompt in SCENE-SPEC.
cards.check: by hand: model opens in the viewer; audit-perf.mjs after loading.
cards.fallback: Use the abstract shapes of svg.mjs gen or CSS depth.

cards.title: Texture and material maps
cards.when: A surface needs a specific look: stone, fabric, brushed metal.
cards.when_not: Flat shaded scenes.
steps: Prompt: material, scale, seamless, PBR maps (albedo, normal, roughness).
Export 1024 px maps; compress to KTX2 or WebP.
Tile-check the seams on a plane.
cards.check: audit-perf.mjs: weight.
cards.fallback: A solid color with roughness and metalness values.

cards.title: AR preview
cards.when: Furniture, decor or products people want to see in their room.
cards.when_not: Everything else.
steps: Prepare a USDZ (iOS) and GLB (Android) model with real-world scale.
Link them with the platform's AR viewer; use the browser's native support.
Keep a 3D viewer and photos as fallback.
cards.check: by hand: opens on a phone.
cards.fallback: 3D viewer and photo gallery.

cards.title: Motion with a purpose
cards.when: Deciding what to animate and how.
cards.when_not: Constant or decorative motion.
steps: Animate only to guide the eye, confirm an action or explain a relation.
Durations: 150 to 250 ms for micro, 300 to 500 ms for panels. Use the motion tokens.
Only transform and opacity; no loops that run all the time.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: animate-layout, transition-all, linear-easing, no-reduced-motion.
cards.fallback: A 150 ms fade.

cards.title: Microinteractions
cards.when: Buttons, toggles, copy, save and drag need to feel alive and confirm themselves.
cards.when_not: Everything on the page at once.
steps: Each control has hover, focus-visible, active and loading states.
Press: scale 0.97 over 100 ms. Toggle: move with the gesture's direction.
Copy and save: change the label for 1.5 s ("Copied").
Errors: shake once or outline, with text.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: outline-removed, transition-all, target-small.
cards.fallback: State color change only.

cards.title: Staggered entrance
cards.when: A group of cards or list items appears on a first view.
cards.when_not: Content below a long scroll, or reduced motion.
steps: Fade and rise 12 to 16 px, 300 to 400 ms, enter easing.
Delay each item by 50 to 100 ms; at most 6 items.
Trigger once, when in view.
Keep content visible if scripts fail.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: animate-layout, no-reduced-motion.
cards.fallback: No animation.

cards.title: Scroll-driven reveal and progress
cards.when: A section that reveals, a progress bar or a story that follows the scroll.
cards.when_not: Long text, or users with reduced motion.
steps: Use CSS `animation-timeline: view()` or `scroll()` where supported.
Reveal with opacity and a short rise; never hide content before it runs.
For stories, one change per section, not per pixel.
Gate it in a `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` block.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: no-reduced-motion, animate-layout.
cards.fallback: IntersectionObserver adding a class once.

cards.title: Hover states
cards.when: Cards, buttons and links that are interactive.
cards.when_not: Touch-only contexts: never hide information behind hover.
steps: Pick one effect per component type: lift, glow, shift or color change.
120 to 200 ms with the standard easing token.
Add the same change to :focus-visible.
Transform and opacity only.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: transition-all, outline-removed.
cards.fallback: A color change.

cards.title: Page transitions
cards.when: Navigating between routes or sections in an app.
cards.when_not: Content sites where speed matters more.
steps: Use the View Transition API for same-document changes.
Fade or slide 200 to 300 ms; one shared element at most.
Skip for reduced motion; keep focus management.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: no-reduced-motion; audit-perf.mjs: TBT.
cards.fallback: Instant navigation.

cards.title: Skeletons and loading states
cards.when: Content that takes more than 300 ms to appear.
cards.when_not: Under 300 ms, or a short action: use a spinner on the button.
steps: Same layout and size as the final content; no layout shift.
A soft pulse, 1.2 s or slower, reduced motion off.
Under 10 s, then an error state with retry.
cards.check: audit-perf.mjs: CLS; audit-design.mjs: no-reduced-motion.
cards.fallback: A spinner with the label "Loading".

cards.title: Cursor and magnetic effects
cards.when: A brand or portfolio page with one hero button.
cards.when_not: Touch devices, apps and forms.
steps: Move the element 4 to 8 px toward the pointer, with a spring.
One element only; keep the hit area the same size.
Disable on touch and reduced motion.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: no-reduced-motion, target-small.
cards.fallback: A hover lift.

cards.title: Text reveal
cards.when: A headline or statement that appears when it enters the view.
cards.when_not: Body text, or more than one reveal in view.
steps: Reveal by lines or words, 400 to 600 ms, stagger 40 to 80 ms.
Clip with `overflow: hidden` on the line and move with transform.
Start only once in the viewport; keep the text readable with scripts off.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: text-clipped, no-reduced-motion.
cards.fallback: A fade in.

cards.title: Parallax
cards.when: Depth in a hero or a story with 2 or 3 layers.
cards.when_not: Text layers, mobile, or reduced motion.
steps: Use 2 or 3 layers moving at 0.9, 0.8 and 1 of the scroll speed.
Move with transform on a compositor layer.
Keep the text static; turn off for reduced motion and small screens.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: animate-layout, no-reduced-motion; audit-perf.mjs: TBT.
cards.fallback: A fixed background image.

cards.title: Lottie or lightweight animations
cards.when: An animated icon, an illustration or a state that is too complex for CSS.
cards.when_not: Simple fades and spins.
steps: Use a vector animation under 100 KB; load it lazily.
Autoplay once; loop only when it signals a wait.
Pause on reduced motion; keep a static first frame.
cards.check: audit-perf.mjs: weight and TBT.
cards.fallback: An animated SVG (svg.mjs gen) or a static image.

cards.title: Accessible modal, drawer and tooltip
cards.when: Any content that opens above the page.
cards.when_not: Information the user must always see: put it in the page.
steps: Move focus in; trap it; Esc and a visible close button close it; return focus to the trigger.
Lock the body scroll; make the overlay scroll inside on small screens.
Tooltips: open on focus too; content is short; never the only place for needed information.
Use the native `dialog` or a tested component from the catalog.
cards.check: audit-a11y.mjs (axe); audit-honesty.mjs: modal-no-close; by hand: keyboard only.
cards.fallback: An inline section or a page.

cards.title: Progressive disclosure
cards.when: Advanced or long information that most people do not need at first.
cards.when_not: Essentials: price, contact, the main action.
steps: Show the common case; hide the rest behind "More", tabs or an accordion.
Label the trigger by its content ("Technical details").
Keep the state in the URL for tabs people share.
Use real buttons with aria-expanded.
cards.check: audit-a11y.mjs; by hand: essentials are visible without a click.
cards.fallback: A long page with anchors.

cards.title: Screen reader test
cards.when: Before closing a page with forms, dialogs or custom controls.
cards.when_not: Static text-only pages: axe is enough.
steps: Test with a real screen reader (NVDA on Windows, VoiceOver on Mac or iOS).
Walk the main flow with the keyboard only; listen to the names, roles and states.
Write each mismatch as a numbered fix.
cards.check: audit-a11y.mjs for the automatic part; the walk is by hand.
cards.fallback: Axe plus a keyboard-only pass.

cards.title: Color-blindness simulation
cards.when: Charts, statuses and any information carried by color.
cards.when_not: Text-only pages.
steps: Use the browser's vision emulation or an external simulator: protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia.
Take a screenshot of each; check that every state is still distinct.
Fix with icons, labels or patterns.
cards.check: by hand: screenshots per type.
cards.fallback: A grayscale screenshot.

cards.title: Section naming
cards.when: Headings and nav labels are "Our services" or "About" on every site.
cards.when_not: Navigation labels people expect ("Pricing", "Contact").
steps: Name a section by its promise or its answer ("How a first order works").
Keep nav labels familiar and short; headings can be specific.
Read the headings alone: they should tell the story.
cards.check: by hand: the headings alone tell the page's story.
cards.fallback: Familiar generic names.

cards.title: Card sorting for the structure
cards.when: Contents that need a menu or categories.
cards.when_not: A site with 3 pages.
steps: Write each content item on a line (the inventory).
Group them as users would, by task or intent, not by company structure.
Name each group with the user's words; max 7 groups.
Ask 3 to 5 real people, or the user, to confirm.
cards.check: recipe.mjs show <id> for the usual groups; ui-map.mjs check.
cards.fallback: Copy the groups of the nearest recipe.

cards.title: Scannable copy
cards.when: Any text people must read quickly.
cards.when_not: Long-form pieces read for pleasure.
steps: One idea per paragraph; 2 to 4 lines each.
Front-load the point; bold at most 1 phrase per paragraph.
Use lists for 3 or more parallel items; headings every 3 to 5 paragraphs.
Cut every sentence that does not change what the reader does.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: line-length; by hand: skim test.
cards.fallback: Shorten each paragraph by half.

cards.title: SEO basics
cards.when: Every public page.
cards.when_not: Private apps.
steps: One h1; unique title (under 60 characters) and meta description (under 160).
Semantic landmarks; descriptive link text; alt on informative images.
Open Graph title, description and image; canonical URL.
Content in HTML, not only in scripts.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: multiple-h1, heading-skip, img-no-alt.
cards.fallback: Title, description and one h1.

cards.title: CMS-ready blocks
cards.when: Content will be edited by people who are not developers.
cards.when_not: One-off pages.
steps: List each section as a block with named fields (title, text, image, link).
Give each field a limit (length, ratio) so the design survives real content.
Keep styling in tokens, not in the content.
Name blocks by purpose ("Feature grid").
cards.check: pieces.mjs find; recipe.mjs show <id> lists sections.
cards.fallback: A markdown file with front matter.

cards.title: Variation set
cards.when: The user is unsure of a hero, a pricing block or a card and needs options to compare.
cards.when_not: A decision already made.
steps: Pick one section; find 3 catalog candidates with find.mjs.
Make 3 variants that change only one thing each: layout, density or emphasis.
Same content and tokens in all; show them side by side.
Record the choice with memory.mjs add.
cards.check: memory.mjs records the decision; audit-design.mjs on the chosen one.
cards.fallback: Two variants: current and one alternative.

cards.title: Creativity by constraint
cards.when: The result looks generic and needs a signature.
cards.when_not: Products where familiarity is the goal.
steps: Set one hard limit: two colors, one typeface, one image, no cards.
Design the whole page inside it.
Add exactly one rule-breaking element, once.
cards.check: tokens.mjs check; audit-design.mjs: too-many-font-sizes, color-literal.
cards.fallback: Remove a color and a font from the design.

cards.title: Mood mixing and reference blending
cards.when: One style does not fit the brand, or two references are each half right.
cards.when_not: More than two sources: it becomes noise.
steps: Pick two directions, one that sets structure and one that sets surface (for example editorial layout with industrial color).
Take composition from reference A and palette from reference B; never copy either.
Write the rule that keeps them apart in DESIGN.md.
Show 2 combinations, not 5.
cards.check: tokens.mjs check; by hand: no element belongs to both.
cards.fallback: One direction and one accent from the other.

cards.title: Style transfer without copying
cards.when: The user likes the style of a page but needs their own content.
cards.when_not: Copying the text, images or a brand mark.
steps: Extract rules from the reference: type pairing, palette roles, spacing rhythm, shape language.
Write them as token values with tokens.mjs init.
Rebuild the user's content with those tokens and different composition.
Credit nothing as copied.
cards.check: tokens.mjs check; audit-design.mjs: color-literal.
cards.fallback: Use the nearest style direction of the kit.

cards.title: A/B variants
cards.when: Two versions of a headline, a hero or a call to action should be compared.
cards.when_not: Low-traffic pages where results will not be reliable.
steps: Change one variable only; write the hypothesis and the metric.
Both versions pass audit-design.mjs and audit-honesty.mjs.
Measure with the team's analytics outside the kit; the kit does not measure conversion.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs and audit-honesty.mjs --strict on both.
cards.fallback: Ask 5 people which one they understand faster.

cards.title: Lock decisions
cards.when: Palette, type, logo or layout must not change while iterating.
cards.when_not: Early exploration.
steps: Record each locked item in DESIGN.md and with memory.mjs add.
Keep values only in design-tokens.json.
Run audit-design.mjs after each round: a color or size outside the tokens is a break.
State the lock in the request: change only X.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: color-literal, font-size-off-scale, arbitrary-value.
cards.fallback: Commit the tokens and review the diff.

cards.title: Natural feedback to concrete change
cards.when: The user says "less corporate", "more editorial", "darker", "fewer cards".
cards.when_not: A precise instruction: just do it.
steps: Map the phrase to tokens: less corporate = warmer neutral, one serif display, fewer borders; darker = dark tokens; fewer cards = lists or open sections.
Change one group of tokens, show it, ask if it is closer.
Record the accepted change with memory.mjs add.
cards.check: tokens.mjs check; audit-design.mjs after the change.
cards.fallback: Ask one question: which part feels wrong, color, type or layout?

cards.title: Visual diff between two versions
cards.when: The user needs to see what changed between two builds.
cards.when_not: Code-only refactors.
steps: Take screenshots of the same pages at 360, 768 and 1280 in each version.
Compare with an image-diff tool or a visual regression service; mark the changed areas.
List the changes as numbered items for the user.
cards.check: @playwright/test screenshots when it is a dependency; by hand otherwise.
cards.fallback: Put the two screenshots side by side.

cards.title: Direct manipulation
cards.when: The user wants to drag, resize or align elements by hand.
cards.when_not: Changes that a clear instruction can make.
steps: Use the visual feedback loop of guide 11 (point and describe the change) or the user's design tool.
Translate the manual change into tokens or classes; never leave pixel offsets.
Run audit-design.mjs: arbitrary values are breaks.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: arbitrary-value, inline-style-size, spacing-off-scale.
cards.fallback: The user describes the change in words.

cards.title: Visual hierarchy
cards.when: Any screen: the eye follows the biggest, most contrasted and most isolated element.
cards.when_not: Never skip it.
steps: Rank: one dominant headline, one primary action, the rest quieter.
Make the rank with size, weight and space first, color second.
Squint test: blur the page; the dominant element must still be clear.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: multiple-primary, too-many-font-sizes; by hand: squint test.
cards.fallback: Bigger headline, smaller everything else.

cards.title: One focal point per viewport
cards.when: A viewport has several things shouting at the same time.
cards.when_not: Dashboards, where scan order matters more.
steps: Name the one thing the viewport is for.
Remove banners, badges and text that compete; quiet the rest.
Reserve the accent color for that thing and the primary action.
cards.check: by hand (polish report): no tool measures attention; audit-design.mjs: multiple-primary.
cards.fallback: Delete the competing element.

cards.title: Big, near, clear call to action (Fitts)
cards.when: A button that people must find and press, especially on a phone.
cards.when_not: Secondary actions, which stay quiet.
steps: At least 44 px high with a wide hit area; 24 px minimum.
Put it next to the content that persuades, in the thumb zone on mobile.
Its label states the outcome ("Create my account").
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: target-small, overlap, multiple-primary.
cards.fallback: Full-width button on mobile.

cards.title: Fewer options (Hick)
cards.when: A decision has many options: plans, filters, menus, buttons.
cards.when_not: Expert tools where users know the options.
steps: Show 3 to 5 options per decision; group the rest.
Highlight one recommendation.
Use filters in steps: category first, then attributes.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: choices-many, nav-long, form-long.
cards.fallback: Move the extra options behind "More".

cards.title: Grouping: proximity, similarity, continuity
cards.when: People should see which things belong together.
cards.when_not: Never skip it.
steps: Proximity: title, text, price and button of one item sit closer than to other items.
Similarity: every card of a type has the same style.
Continuity: align edges so the eye follows one line.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: spacing-off-scale; by hand (polish report): grouping by relation.
cards.fallback: A gap of 24 between groups and 8 inside.

cards.title: Figure-ground and closure
cards.when: The content gets lost in the background, or shapes are suggested.
cards.when_not: Never skip it.
steps: Calm background; sharp content; accent only for actions.
Closure: partial shapes, masks and implied outlines only where the form is easy to complete.
Check that no decoration crosses text.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: contrast-low, overlap.
cards.fallback: A flat background and one surface level.

cards.title: One idea per block and chunking
cards.when: A card or section mixes price, warranty, specs and testimony.
cards.when_not: Never skip it.
steps: One block, one idea, one next action.
3 to 4 groups of information per screen at most; chunks of 3 to 5 items.
Split a block that needs a second headline.
cards.check: by hand (polish report): grouping; recipe.mjs show <id> for section jobs.
cards.fallback: Split the block in two.

cards.title: Steps with honest progress
cards.when: A long form, checkout or onboarding.
cards.when_not: A form of 3 or fewer fields.
steps: 3 to 5 short steps with a visible "2 of 4".
Save each step; allow back without loss.
The bar must reach 100 % at the real end; never fake it.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: form-long; by hand: progress is true.
cards.fallback: One page with sections and a summary.

cards.title: Smart defaults, prefill and recognition
cards.when: Users would have to decide or remember many things.
cards.when_not: Consent and paid options: those start off.
steps: Preselect the most common safe choice; never the most expensive.
Prefill known data; show a summary instead of asking to recall.
Let people change each default easily.
cards.check: audit-honesty.mjs: prechecked-extra, prechecked-component.
cards.fallback: Ask with a short list and a recommended mark.

cards.title: Immediate feedback
cards.when: Every action: save, add, send, error.
cards.when_not: Never skip it.
steps: Respond within 100 ms (state change); show "Saved", "Added", "Sent" in words.
Show progress for work over 1 s.
Say what happened and what is next.
cards.check: by hand (polish report): every action gives feedback.
cards.fallback: A text confirmation under the control.

cards.title: Error prevention
cards.when: Forms and destructive actions.
cards.when_not: Never skip it.
steps: Constrain input (type, mask, date picker) before validating.
Confirm only destructive actions, and offer undo instead where possible.
Explain how to fix each error where it happens.
cards.check: audit-a11y.mjs; by hand: errors name the field.
cards.fallback: Inline hints under each field.

cards.title: Completion moment (peak-end)
cards.when: The user finishes something: order, profile, first project.
cards.when_not: Rewards without value or badges that mean nothing.
steps: Confirm clearly, show the value delivered and the next step.
A short celebration of 400 ms or less, off for reduced motion.
Make the end of the flow the best moment: thanks, summary, what happens next.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: no-reduced-motion; by hand (polish report): the reward is real.
cards.fallback: A clear success message with the next action.

cards.title: User control, exits and momentum
cards.when: Flows where people could feel trapped or lose work.
cards.when_not: Never skip it.
steps: Every screen has a way back, cancel or close.
Save drafts automatically; resume where they left.
Allow skip, edit and undo; avoid forced flows.
cards.check: audit-honesty.mjs: modal-no-close; by hand (polish report): back, cancel or undo.
cards.fallback: A visible Back link and an autosave note.

cards.title: Progressive commitment and fair exchange
cards.when: You need data or an account from someone who has not seen value yet.
cards.when_not: Asking everything before showing anything.
steps: Ask the minimum first; ask more later when the value is clear.
If you ask for an email, give something useful in return: a template, a quote, a demo.
Say why each field is needed.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: form-long; by hand: value comes before the ask.
cards.fallback: Offer a guest path.

cards.title: Useful, explained and controllable recommendations
cards.when: Suggestions, related items, personalization.
cards.when_not: Sensitive data or recommendations nobody can switch off.
steps: Base them on real behavior or stated interest, not only on popularity.
Say why: "Because you viewed X".
Let people hide, change or reset them.
cards.check: by hand: reason shown and control present.
cards.fallback: Editor's picks by category.

cards.title: Segment by intent
cards.when: Different visitors need different paths.
cards.when_not: Only one audience.
steps: Offer 2 to 4 intent choices ("I am a company", "I need support").
Route each to its own page or section; do not hide the others.
Name choices by the user's goal.
cards.check: recipe.mjs show <id>; by hand: each path ends in one action.
cards.fallback: A single page with anchors per audience.

cards.title: Remember preferences
cards.when: Language, theme, filters and last searches.
cards.when_not: Without consent where law requires it.
steps: Store language, theme and filters locally.
Restore them on return; offer a reset.
Do not store sensitive data.
cards.check: by hand: preference survives a reload.
cards.fallback: Use the browser's language and color scheme.

cards.title: Clarity before cleverness (3-second test)
cards.when: The first screen of any page.
cards.when_not: Never skip it.
steps: The headline says what it is and for whom, in plain words.
Microcopy is human: "We help you launch your shop", not "Innovative digital solutions".
Ask someone to say what it is after 3 seconds.
cards.check: by hand (polish report): clear in 3 seconds.
cards.fallback: Rewrite the headline as "<what> for <who>".

cards.title: One dominant emotion
cards.when: Choosing and checking the look: calm, trust, luxury, energy, curiosity or closeness.
cards.when_not: Several emotions at once.
steps: Pick one from the brief.
Check type, color, image, motion and copy all say it.
Alternate calm and emphasis along the page.
cards.check: by hand against the chosen direction in STYLE-DIRECTIONS.md.
cards.fallback: Remove what does not fit.

cards.title: Real people and specific images
cards.when: Teams, testimonials and heroes that need closeness and trust.
cards.when_not: Stock faces claimed as customers.
steps: Use real photos of the team, product or result.
Show the product or the context of use, not generic office shots.
An honest small imperfection beats a perfect fake.
cards.check: audit-honesty.mjs: placeholder-proof; by hand: images are real.
cards.fallback: An illustration in your system.

cards.title: A button that promises something concrete
cards.when: Any call to action or curious link.
cards.when_not: Clickbait that does not deliver.
steps: Verb plus outcome: "Create my account", "See pricing".
Add a line of reassurance next to it: "No card needed", "Cancel any time".
Tell what happens next: demo, price, download.
cards.check: audit-honesty.mjs --strict; by hand (polish report): says what happens.
cards.fallback: Replace "Submit" with a verb and an outcome.

cards.title: Focused hero
cards.when: The first screen of a landing or home page.
cards.when_not: App screens.
steps: One message, one primary action, one visual that explains the benefit.
A line of proof close by ("Used by 120 workshops", only when true).
Avoid the generic centered hero if you need personality.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: multiple-primary, multiple-h1; recipe.mjs show marketing-landing hero.
cards.fallback: Headline, one line, one button, one image.

cards.title: Contextual call to action and closing microaction
cards.when: Long pages where the action should repeat at the right moments.
cards.when_not: After every two lines.
steps: Repeat the main action after the value or the proof is explained.
End every block with one clear microaction.
Finish the page with a decision, not a messy footer.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: multiple-primary; by hand (polish report): the page ends with one action.
cards.fallback: The main button in the hero and before the footer.

cards.title: Proof next to the objection
cards.when: People hesitate about price, trust, complexity or time.
cards.when_not: Proof that is not real.
steps: Name the objection in PRODUCT.md (O1, O2).
Place the testimonial, number or guarantee that answers it right beside it.
Cite the id in UX-SPEC (Serves).
cards.check: flow.mjs done ux.spec checks the Serves ids; audit-honesty.mjs: placeholder-proof.
cards.fallback: A short FAQ answer next to the price.

cards.title: Scroll as a story
cards.when: Any page longer than one screen.
cards.when_not: Task screens.
steps: Order: attention, interest, proof, objection, action; recipe.mjs show <id> gives the order per page type.
Each section answers a question ("What is this?", "Why do I care?", "How does it work?", "What do I do?").
Each block makes the next decision easier; end with a clear closing action.
cards.check: recipe.mjs check; by hand: headings alone tell the story.
cards.fallback: Use the nearest recipe.

cards.title: Section hooks and scroll cues
cards.when: Content that continues below the fold.
cards.when_not: Hiding the essentials.
steps: Each section opens with a question or a benefit.
Show a clue that more follows: a cut-off card, an arrow, a next heading.
Reveal detail only when it adds context.
cards.check: by hand: the next section is hinted.
cards.fallback: A clear heading at the top of each section.

cards.title: Essentials always visible
cards.when: Price, contact and the main action.
cards.when_not: Never hide them.
steps: No search needed to find price, contact or the main button.
Put them in the first screen and the closing section.
Repeat in the header or a sticky bar if the page is long.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: multiple-primary; by hand: found in 5 seconds.
cards.fallback: A sticky contact link.

cards.title: Minimal form
cards.when: Any form.
cards.when_not: Never skip it.
steps: Ask only what the next step needs.
Visible labels; one column on mobile; correct autocomplete and input types.
Group related fields; mark optional ones.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: form-long; audit-a11y.mjs for labels.
cards.fallback: Split into steps.

cards.title: Form feedback and recovery
cards.when: Validation and errors.
cards.when_not: Never skip it.
steps: Validate on blur; show success and errors by the field.
Say how to fix: "Enter a valid email".
Keep what the user typed; focus the first error; list errors at the top for long forms.
cards.check: audit-a11y.mjs; by hand: send an invalid form.
cards.fallback: A summary at the top of the form.

cards.title: One primary action
cards.when: Any screen.
cards.when_not: Never skip it.
steps: Name the one action the screen is for (G1 in PRODUCT.md).
Filled style for that one; outline or text for the rest.
Do not repeat it more than the story needs.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: multiple-primary.
cards.fallback: Make every other button secondary.

cards.title: Group navigation by intent
cards.when: A menu that mirrors the company's structure.
cards.when_not: Tiny sites.
steps: Group by what the user wants to do.
5 to 7 items; move the rest into a "More" or footer.
Add search when there is a lot of content, and filters in steps.
cards.check: audit-design.mjs: nav-long.
cards.fallback: Use the groups of the nearest recipe.

cards.title: Show the current location
cards.when: Menus, steps, tabs and long documents.
cards.when_not: One-page sites with no navigation.
steps: Mark the current item (aria-current and a visible style).
Use breadcrumbs in deep structures.
Show the step number in flows.
cards.check: audit-a11y.mjs; by hand: the current item is visible.
cards.fallback: Page title and a breadcrumb.

cards.title: Familiar patterns and labels
cards.when: Navigation, cart, search, buttons.
cards.when_not: Never replace a familiar label with a clever one.
steps: Logo top left, menu at the top, cart top right, search as a field with a lens.
Use plain labels: Search, Cart, Contact, See pricing.
Break a convention only with a reason you can say in one line.
cards.check: by hand against the catalog entry from find.mjs.
cards.fallback: Copy the pattern from a catalog entry.

cards.title: Specific, credible social proof
cards.when: Testimonials, logos, numbers and press.
cards.when_not: Invented or vague claims.
steps: Specific beats big: "Used by 120 industrial workshops".
Testimonials: who, what problem, what result.
Add logos, certifications or cases only if real.
cards.check: audit-honesty.mjs: placeholder-proof, unverified-metric.
cards.fallback: Remove the proof you cannot source.

cards.title: Transparent price
cards.when: Anything that costs money.
cards.when_not: Never hide the price.
steps: Show the price or a range; avoid "Contact us" when you can.
Show the total, with taxes and fees, early.
Compare plans on the same items.
cards.check: audit-honesty.mjs: hidden-fee.
cards.fallback: "From X" plus what changes the price.

cards.title: Lower the risk and state the policy
cards.when: The user hesitates before committing.
cards.when_not: Guarantees you will not honor.
steps: Give a trial, demo, guarantee or clear return.
Link refund, privacy, cancellation and support from where the decision happens.
Write policies in plain language.
cards.check: audit-honesty.mjs: subscription-no-cancel, hard-cancel.
cards.fallback: A one-line policy next to the button.

cards.title: Real urgency only
cards.when: A real deadline or real stock exists.
cards.when_not: Fake timers, "only 2 left", fake demand.
steps: Show the real date or the real number, from data.
Never reset a timer.
Without a real deadline, use value ("Free shipping this week" only if true).
cards.check: audit-honesty.mjs: fake-scarcity, urgency-copy, countdown-timer, fomo-activity.
cards.fallback: Remove the urgency.

cards.title: Cancellation as easy as signing up
cards.when: Subscriptions, trials and accounts.
cards.when_not: Never hide it.
steps: Show the renewal date and price before the user pays.
Cancel in the same place and in one or two clicks.
Confirm with an email.
cards.check: audit-honesty.mjs: subscription-no-cancel, hard-cancel.
cards.fallback: A visible "Cancel" in the account page.

cards.title: Balanced and explicit consent
cards.when: Cookies, newsletters and data sharing.
cards.when_not: Pre-checked boxes and tiny reject buttons.
steps: Accept and reject have the same size, weight and place.
Nothing is preselected; consent is a clear action.
Popups close with a button, Esc and a click outside.
cards.check: audit-honesty.mjs: consent-asymmetry, tiny-decline, prechecked-extra, prechecked-component, modal-no-close, confirmshaming.
cards.fallback: Two equal buttons: Accept, Reject.

cards.title: Feeds with an end
cards.when: Lists and feeds that could scroll forever.
cards.when_not: Endless scroll with no limit.
steps: Use a load-more button or pagination with the count ("24 of 120").
Keep the footer reachable.
Remember the scroll position when going back.
cards.check: audit-honesty.mjs: infinite-scroll.
cards.fallback: Pagination.

cards.title: Persona pass
cards.when: Before closing a page, to look through different eyes.
cards.when_not: Never skip it.
steps: Read the page as: a first-time visitor, an expert, a phone user in a hurry, a distrustful person, someone with low vision.
For each, write the first thing that confuses them.
Fix the top three.
cards.check: by hand; audit-design.mjs at 360; audit-a11y.mjs.
cards.fallback: Test with the first-time visitor and the phone user.

cards.title: Attention map
cards.when: A key screen where you want to see where people will look.
cards.when_not: Any screen you can judge with the squint test.
steps: Use an attention-prediction tool or an eye-tracking study outside the kit on a screenshot.
Compare the heat with the intended order: headline, proof, action.
Write the competing elements as numbered fixes.
cards.check: by hand: the intended element is the hottest.
cards.fallback: The squint and the 3-second test of single-focal-point.
